login.title: Log in
login.subtitle: Private login. Audio is muxed as-is and is never synthesized.

create.title: New talking portrait
create.intro: Upload a portrait and your own mp3. Only the picture is driven. The voice stays the original file.
create.modeOriginalDesc: Keep the background in the photo and drive the mouth with your original audio.
create.modePresetDesc: Cut the person out, place them in a chosen scene, then drive the mouth with your original audio.
create.portraitHint: JPG, PNG, or WEBP, up to {{size}} MB. Front-facing, with clear features.
create.audioHint: MP3 only, up to {{max}} seconds. The file is muxed unchanged: no voice change, cloning, or speech synthesis.
create.offsetHint: Negative moves the voice earlier. Positive delays it. This only shifts the start, not the voice.
create.agreementLabel: I have the right to use this portrait and audio, and I understand the video is a synthetic picture with a fixed watermark and AI metadata.
create.pipelineNote: Until the models are connected, the file is a still picture plus your original audio, the watermark, and AI metadata. That path checks the queue and storage. Lip motion and background removal start after LivePortrait and rembg are mounted.

city_night.title: City night

agreement.title: Use notes and synthetic-content notice
agreement.intro: Embodiment (化身) makes talking portraits from your own voice. This version is for private use. Subscriptions come later.
agreement.s1Body: Upload only portraits and audio you have the right to use. Do not upload someone else's face or recording unless they have allowed it.
agreement.s2Body: Audio passes through. The system does not synthesize speech, clone a voice, or rewrite the recording. The voice in the video is your mp3. Lip-sync offset only moves where the sound starts against the picture.
agreement.s3Body: The picture is driven from the photo. You can keep the selfie background, or place the person in a preset scene. The video burns in the watermark “化身 Embodiment AI合成内容” and marks the file metadata as AI-generated.
agreement.s4Body: Each video is at most 30 seconds. Longer audio is stopped on the page and is not queued.
agreement.s5Body: Login is private. There is no public sign-up. Billing and multiple accounts will be added in a later version.
agreement.s6Body: You are responsible for what you upload and how you use the result. Do not present it as a live appearance, and do not strip the synthetic-content label before sharing it.

errors.UNKNOWN: That did not finish. Try again shortly.
errors.NETWORK: The service is unreachable. Check that the API is running.
errors.UNAUTHORIZED: The login expired. Sign in again.
errors.INVALID_CREDENTIALS: The username or password is wrong.
errors.TEMPLATE_UNKNOWN: That scene template is not available.
errors.OFFSET_OUT_OF_RANGE: The lip-sync offset is outside the allowed range.
errors.IMAGE_INVALID: That photo format is not supported. Use JPG, PNG, or WEBP.
errors.AUDIO_INVALID: This audio could not be read. Choose another MP3.
errors.AUDIO_TOO_LONG: The audio is over {{max}} seconds (this file is {{seconds}} seconds). Trim it to 30 seconds or less.
errors.OUTPUT_NOT_READY: The video is not ready yet.
errors.QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE: The queue is unavailable. Check that Redis and Celery are running.
errors.STORAGE_UNAVAILABLE: Object storage is unavailable. Check that MinIO is running.
errors.FFMPEG_MISSING: ffmpeg was not found on the server.
errors.FONT_MISSING: The server has no font that can draw the Chinese watermark.
errors.INFERENCE_FAILED: Generation failed. Check the photo, the audio, and ffmpeg.
errors.RUNPOD_NOT_CONFIGURED: Runpod is selected, but the endpoint is not configured.
errors.RUNPOD_FAILED: Runpod did not return a video.
